title: Aoristus Secundus
subtitle: Aoristus “secundus” (fortis): thema mūtātum (λείπω → ἔλιπον), dēsinentiae identicae imperfectō; necessitās discendī sīgillātim.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē aoristum secundum āctīvum et medium verbī λείπω (relinquō) → ἔλιπον
Explicāre cūr aoristus secundus adhibeat dēsinentiās identicās imperfectō, distīnctus sōlum per thema mūtātum
Recognōscere necessitātem discendī thema aoristī secundī sīgillātim prō quōque verbō (nōn est regula praedictīva)
Recitāre themata aoristī secundī frequentissima: λαμβάνω/ἔλαβον, ἔρχομαι/ἦλθον, ὁράω/εἶδον, λέγω/εἶπον

content.intro: Multa verba Graeca frequentissima — praesertim thema brevī vel antīquō — nōn adhibent σ prō aoristō, sed mūtant thema ipsum, adhibentēs dēsinentiās IDENTICAS illīs imperfectī (Gradū III). Hic patrōnus vocātur “aoristus secundus” (vel “fortis”): λείπω (relinquō, praesēns) → ἔλιπον (relīquī, aoristus) — comparā Anglicum “sing/sang”, “eat/ate” (mūtātiō vōcālis interna), vel Latīnum “videō/vīdī”.
content.explanation: Fōrmātiō: augmentum + THEMA MŪTĀTUM (nōn thema praesentis) + dēsinentiae SECUNDĀRIAE (identicae imperfectō: -ον, -ες, -ε, -ομεν, -ετε, -ον). Nūllum σ hīc adest. Discrīmen ā praesentī/imperfectō est SŌLUM in themate ipsō (λειπ- praesēns/imperf. vs. λιπ- aoristus), nōn in dēsinentiīs.

rules.heading: a) Aoristus Secundus Āctīvus: ἔλιπον
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªἔλιπονἐλίπομεν
2ªἔλιπεςἐλίπετε
3ªἔλιπε(ν)ἔλιπον

Compara cum imperfectō ἔλυον (Gradū III): dēsinentiae -ον, -ες, -ε(ν)... sunt IDENTICAE. Sōlum thema differt (λιπ- hīc, dērīvātum ā λειπ- per mūtātiōnem vōcālis, ει→ι). Īnfīnītīvus: λιπεῖν (accentū -εῖν, sīcut praesēns, dīversē ab -αι aoristī prīmī).

rules.heading: b) Aoristus Secundus Medius: ἐλιπόμην
rules.body: Medium sequitur idem patrōnum: ἐλιπόμην, ἐλίπου, ἐλίπετο (sg.) — ἐλιπόμεθα, ἐλίπεσθε, ἐλίποντο (pl.). Dēsinentiae sunt identicae imperfectō mediō-passīvō (Gradū III); sōlum thema (λιπ- prō λυ-) differt. Īnfīnītīvus: λιπέσθαι.

rules.heading: c) Themata Frequentissima Discenda Sīgillātim
rules.body:
PraesēnsAoristus SecundusSēnsus
λαμβάνωἔλαβονcapiō, sūmō
ἔρχομαιἦλθονveniō, eō
ὁράωεἶδονvideō
λέγωεἶπονdīcō
βάλλωἔβαλονiaciō

Nōn exsistit rēgula praedictīva quae themata revēlet ab fōrmā praesentis sōlā — thema aoristī secundī est parte “fōrmārum prīncipālium” (principal parts) verbī, discendum et memoriae mandandum cum ipsō verbō, sīcut fōrmae irregulārēs Anglicae (“go/went”) vel Latīnae (“ferō/tulī”).

examples: ἔλαβε τὸ βιβλίον. — Cēpit/sūmpsit librum. (3ª sg., λαμβάνω → ἔλαβον)
ἦλθομεν εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν. — Vēnimus ad forum. (1ª pl., ἔρχομαι → ἦλθον)
εἶδες τὸν βασιλέα; — Vīdistīne rēgem? (2ª sg., ὁράω → εἶδον)
τί εἶπεν ὁ ῥήτωρ; — Quid dīxit ōrātor? (3ª sg., λέγω → εἶπον)
οἱ στρατιῶται ἔβαλον λίθους. — Mīlitēs iēcērunt lapidēs. (βάλλω → ἔβαλον)

commonMistakes.wrong: Quaerere σ in aoristō secundō, applicandō patrōnum aoristī prīmī indiscrīminātim ad omne verbum.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī aoristus secundus NUMQUAM habet σ; identificātur per thema mūtātum + dēsinentiae imperfectī-similēs.
commonMistakes.why: Verba frequentissima (λαμβάνω, ἔρχομαι, ὁράω, λέγω) sunt praecīsē illa quae adhibent hunc patrōnum, ergō error hīc afficit ūsum cotīdiānum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Temptāre dērīvāre thema aoristī secundī ā themate praesentis per rēgulam generālem, sine memoriā speciālī.
commonMistakes.right: Discere thema aoristī secundī sīgillātim, ut pars fōrmārum prīncipālium verbī, exāctē sīcut fōrmās irregulārēs linguārum modernārum.
commonMistakes.why: Themata haec dērīvant ā fōrmīs Indoeuropaeīs antīquīs sine patrōnō praedictīvō synchronicō.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere aoristum secundum significāre aliquid dīversum aspectuāliter ab aoristō prīmō.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī ambō genera (prīmus/secundus) significant idem aspectum (āctiō simplex) — discrīmen est purē morphologicum.
commonMistakes.why: Repetītiō necessāria ex lēctiōne priōre: terminologia refert ad classem fōrmālem, nōn ad sēnsum.

exercises.title: Coniugā Aoristum Secundum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā aoristī secundī.

items.prompt: Ἐγὼ τὴν πόλιν ___. (1ª sg. aor., λείπω, “relīquī”)
items.explanation: Aoristus secundus, 1ª sg.: ἔλιπον (thema mūtātum, sine σ).

items.prompt: Σὺ τὸ βιβλίον ___. (2ª sg. aor., λαμβάνω, “cēpistī”)
Ἡμεῖς εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν ___. (1ª pl. aor., ἔρχομαι, “vēnimus”)
items.explanation: Aoristus secundus, 1ª pl.: ἤλθομεν (thema ἐλθ-, augmentum vocālicum).

items.prompt: Ὁ ῥήτωρ τί ___; (3ª sg. aor., λέγω, “dīxit”)

items.explanation: Īnfīnītīvus aoristī secundī: ἰδεῖν (thema ιδ-, sine augmentō in īnfīnītīvō).
Aoristus secundus numquam habet σ; distinguitur per thema mūtātum.

options: fōrmās novās, prōpriās sōlī aoristō secundō

items.prompt: Potestne thema aoristī secundī praedīcī ā themate praesentis per rēgulam generālem?
options: nōn, dēbet discī sīgillātim prō quōque verbō
items.explanation: Thema aoristī secundī nōn est praedictibile; est pars fōrmārum prīncipālium discendārum.

items.prompt: Quod est aoristus secundus verbī λαμβάνω?
items.explanation: Λαμβάνω → ἔλαβον, cāsus classicus aoristī secundī.

items.prompt: Significant aoristus prīmus et secundus aspectūs dīversōs?
options: nōn, ambō significant āctiōnem simplicem; discrīmen est morphologicum
aoristus secundus est semper plūs formālis
items.explanation: Repetītiō necessāria: sōlum morphologia differt, nōn sēnsus.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Aoristus secundus adhibet thema mūtātum ā themate praesentis, sine σ.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: λείπω → ἔλιπον, mūtātiō vōcālis interna.

items.statement: Dēsinentiae aoristī secundī sunt identicae illīs imperfectī.
Verbum λέγω fōrmat aoristum suum sigmaticē (cum σ), sīcut λύω.
items.explanation: Falsum: λέγω habet aoristum secundum (εἶπον), sine σ, thema speciāle.

items.statement: Themata aoristī secundī possunt semper dērīvārī ā regulā generālī phōnologicā.
items.explanation: Falsum: dēbent discī sīgillātim, sīcut fōrmae irregulārēs cuiuslibet linguae.

summary: Aoristus secundus (λείπω → ἔλιπον): thema mūtātum, SINE σ, dēsinentiae identicae imperfectō.
Ἔλιπον, ἔλιπες, ἔλιπε(ν) // ἐλίπομεν, ἐλίπετε, ἔλιπον. Īnfīnītīvus: λιπεῖν.
Themata frequentissima: λαμβάνω/ἔλαβον, ἔρχομαι/ἦλθον, ὁράω/εἶδον, λέγω/εἶπον, βάλλω/ἔβαλον — discenda sīgillātim.
Aoristus prīmus et secundus sunt aspectuāliter identicī (āctiō simplex); discrīmen est purē morphologicum, sīcut classificātiō fōrmārum prīncipālium irregulārium.
